Comment.value: Rune of Expansion: consumable that binds +1 forge property slot into ONE targeted item (item-local FORGE_EXTRA_SLOTS, capped at FORGE_TOKEN_MAX_SLOTS in forge_inc.nss). Activate (Unique Power, targeted) then click the item to expand. Dispatched by dmfi_activate -> slot_token.nss. Drop-source/rarity is a deferred admin decision. (roadmap: item-slot-tokens)

value.0:
A rune-etched shard of star-iron, warm to the touch, torn from the hoard of a fallen lord. Bound into a weapon or piece of gear at the forge's reckoning, it widens the very lattice of the item -- letting a smith bind one more enchantment into it than the law would otherwise allow.

Activate the rune, then target the item in your pack you wish to expand. The rune is consumed, and that item may thereafter bear one additional forge enchantment (up to three runes may be bound into a single item). The expansion is intrinsic to the item and travels with it.
